newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kawasaki, Mitsui to make steel bars in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Kawasaki, Mitsui to make steel bars in Philippines.

text.p: Kawasaki Steel Corp, Mitsui & Co Ltd and other Japanese and Philippine companies will set up a joint venture to make and sell steel bars in the Philippines, Kawasaki said on Thursday.
The total investment for the project is expected to be 16 billion yen, it said in a statement.
The major steel maker said the venture, Bacnotan Steel Industries Inc, will be capitalised at seven billion yen and 13.3 percent owned by Kawasaki and 10.7 percent by Mitsui.
Philippine Investment-Management Consultants Inc and its group company, Bacnotan Consolidated Industries Inc, are to take a 70 percent stake in the venture, it said.
Kawasaki said the venture will begin operations in January and have production capacity of 320,000 tonnes of steel bars a year.
The Philippines is currently undergoing a construction boom and there is increasing demand for building materials such as steel bars, Kawasaki said.
